bio.text: Laurin Hendrix, a Republican, has represented District 14 in the Arizona House of Representatives since January 9, 2023, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
He was born in California, lives in Gilbert, Arizona, and earned a B.S. from the University of California at Irvine.
His career experience includes owning a number of small businesses, and he served as a member and president of the Maricopa County Community College District governing board.
